The company enjoyed a 13% increase in operational revenue, totaling 320.96 crore. Their hotel segment excelled with a Gross Bookings Value surpassing 100 crores, reflecting a remarkable 159% year-on-year growth and driving significant revenue increase, largely from its loyal user base utilizing various transportation services.

primary.title: Jio Platforms IPO, Paras Healthcare issue to drive primary market activity this week
primary.summary: Jio Platforms is gearing up for an impressive ₹30,213-crore initial public offering, set to debut on October 21. Following suit, Paras Healthcare is also preparing to launch its own ₹1,450 crore IPO. Meanwhile, several companies whose IPOs wrapped up last week will be hitting the stock market this week, including Vaibhav Vyapaar, Ravita Engineering Services, and Shellz India. This week undoubtedly showcases dynamic shifts in the primary market landscape.
